contract.goal: a file-action submission whose cancellation was requested ends CANCELLED (envelope CANCELLED), never APPLIED, on the direct, deferred and confirm paths, audited as file-action.cancelled, as specified in specs/interactive-file-action and specs/file-action-admin
contract.output: FileActionState.CANCELLED; FileActionAuditActions.CANCELLED; stateFor/failureCodeFor/finish/applyFromArtifact; pre-apply checkpoint; conditional VALIDATED->CANCELLED; FileActionCancelIT; FileActionAdminIT updated; README EN+RU; follow-ups updated
constraints: no migration (state is VARCHAR(32), no check constraint)
no rollback of rows applied before a stop

decisions: 1.x: FileActionState.CANCELLED(OperationStatus.CANCELLED) and FileActionAuditActions.CANCELLED='file-action.cancelled'; javadoc corrected about RuleGroup.OPERATIONS (it flags enums made only of vocabulary words). mvn -o -pl :file-action-spring-boot-starter test: 278 run, 0 failures (ArchUnit included).

2.1: the outcome-to-state mapping moved from FileActionService's private stateFor/failureCodeFor onto ApplyOutcome.endState()/failureCode() (public record) so a unit test can reach it from the unit package. A stop wins: CANCELLED with no failure code, even after a rolled-back batch. finish and applyFromArtifact record file-action.cancelled for a stop (success=true) instead of file-action.applied. ApplyOutcomeTest 3/3; module 281 run, 0 failures.

2.2: one checkpoint in afterBinding, after the too-many-rejects check and BEFORE the validate/confirm branch and the apply, ends the submission CANCELLED (rowsApplied 0, file-action.cancelled). Placed before the mode branch, not only before ApplyPass, so a cancel arriving while the file is read also stops VALIDATE_ONLY and CONFIRM submissions.

2.3 (design refinement): the confirm path's store.transition(APPLYING) loads the row fresh and saves, so it would overwrite a CANCELLED written by a conditional cancel. Both sides are now conditional QueryDSL updates on state = VALIDATED that bump the version: cancelIfValidated (cancel/cancelByAdministrator, via one shared requestCancellation) and startIfValidated (applyFromArtifact, which returns the reloaded CANCELLED row when it loses). Exactly one wins. Not a flag checkpoint on the confirm path - the conditional start makes it unnecessary.

2.2-2.4: FileActionCancelIT with three @Nested contexts (DEFERRED ALL_OR_NOTHING; CONFIRM INLINE; PER_BATCH batch-size 2 with RecordingOrderHandler.pauseAfter holding batch 1 open), a RecordingSink AuditSink delegate. 5/5: cancelled-before-claim (no row applied, CANCELLED, audit has cancellation-requested+cancelled, no applied), cancelled-again (no extra audit), VALIDATED ends at once + confirm refused (SubmissionStateException, CONFLICT), administrator cancel of VALIDATED, between-batches (rowsApplied 2, A-1/A-2 only, CANCELLED).

failures: 3.1 attempt 1: FileActionAdminIT.cancelsAValidatedSubmission answered 202 PENDING although the row was CANCELLED. Cause: open-in-view - the MockMvc request holds one EntityManager, JpaTransactionManager reuses it even for REQUIRES_NEW when no transaction is active, and the QueryDSL bulk update bypasses it, so reload() returned the stale VALIDATED copy. FileActionCancelIT missed it because it calls the service outside a request.
